backstory:
# Backstory — Sable

## The Name

**Sable** — the heraldic word for black. A color name for someone who
sees the dark only in shades of grey, from a people who lost color entirely and
have been chasing it ever since. It reads as a name, not a statement, which is why it works.

The one question it leaves open: **given or taken?**

- **Given** — your parents named you for the absence, the way their parents named them. You have
  never once thought about it. Serene about the monochrome; the sourcebook's first camp.
- **Taken** — you chose the blackest word you could find and wore it, after whatever made you
  masterless. A name that says *I know what I am now.* The second camp, chasing color, and
  angrier about it.

## Age & Appearance

**230 years old**, born ~1480 P.A.I. Shadar-kai live past 750, so Sable is roughly a human in
his early thirties — an adult with five centuries still ahead. The age is chosen to put him
inside two specific events on Cedmaran's timeline *(1 Our Past & Present.pdf, pp. 8–9)*:

| Then | Sable was | What it means |
|---|:--:|---|
| **The Shattering**, ~1500 P.A.I. | **~20** | The cooperative cities broke into war. If a master's tradition died anywhere, it died here. |
| **The Dissolution**, ~1600 P.A.I. | **~120** | **Modern gunpowder** perfected, "refined to discourage all future wars." A trained swordsman, adult, watching his whole discipline become negotiable. |

> [!important] This is where the revolver comes from
> The gun isn't a tool Sable picked up. It's the thing that happened *to* him — and choosing to
> carry one is a verdict on a tradition that was already gone. That answers the prompt below.

**5'9" / 175 cm, ~145 lb / 66 kg.** Wiry and corded, built for speed and reach rather than
leverage — DEX 17 against STR 12, and it shows. Ashen grey skin, black hair, pale colorless eyes.

Two things worth playing at the table:

- **Sable can see color perfectly well.** The Shadar-Kai lost color *in themselves*, not the
  ability to perceive it — Darkvision only greys things out in the dark. He walks
  through a world full of color carrying none of it, which is exactly what makes Kismet's
  *"fill the world with color"* something he can actually chase.
- **He ages visibly in the Shadowfell.** Shadar-kai become wizened there and youthful again on
  the Material Plane. If the party ever crosses over, Sable gets old in front of the table.

## The Prompts That Matter

The subclass and species hand you a story that rhymes with itself. The Ronin are
**"masterless, wandering warriors, beholden to no code but their own — no two the same, each
with their own tale that led them down the warrior's path."** The Shadar-Kai were
**"blessed by Chaos, forever lost any color, and left to wander, drawn to color more than ever
before."**

Both are about someone who lost the thing that defined them and went looking.

- **Who was your master, and how did you become masterless?** Death, betrayal, dismissal, or
  your own choice to walk away? The Ronin text splits into two camps — vigilantes protecting the
  vulnerable "no matter the cost," and those pursuing "their own justice, unfettered by the
  consequences." Which one are you, and were you always?
- **Where did the gun come from?** Firearms are uncommon in Cedmaran, and the doc frames them as
  a **"great equalizer"** that "blurs the old boundaries between martial skill and arcane might."
  A trained swordsman who picked up a pistol has made a statement about tradition. Who did that
  offend?
- **What is the code you kept?** Beholden to no code *but your own* — so what is yours? One
  sentence. It should be something the table can watch you break.
- **What are you looking for?** The Shadar-Kai chase color. What's yours?

## Hooks into the Campaign

The DM's pitch: *"assist the **Echo's Call** in establishing a new haven for the people. But be
warned, the world is unsteady."* Themes: exploration, survival, a dynamic world, hope through
paving new ground.

- **Why do you care about a new haven?** A masterless warrior with no lord and no home is the
  ideal recruit for people building one. Do you want a place to belong, or are you escorting
  other people toward something you don't believe you get to have?
- ~~Ask the DM about the Echo's Call~~ — **answered.** It's the Echo Hunters' **guild call
  for adventurers**, not a faction. Sable answered a public notice and walked in the front door
  with strangers, so **no prior tie is required**. That's a freedom, not a gap: if you want him
  to have a history with the guild, it's now a choice rather than a hole to fill.
- The world has **waned** over centuries: nations collapsed, peoples condensed, history fell to
  ruin. Your master's tradition may be one of the things that fell. You could be the last person
  who knows a style.

## Ties to Cedmaran

- **Deity — ✅ Kismet, the Painter of Fate** *(2 Deities & Patrons.pdf, p. 12)*. True Neutral;
  Fate, Prophecy, Painters, the Unknown; Arcana domain; a paintbrush for a symbol. A small young
  woman in a white gown splotched with paint, hair moonlight silver and untouched. She predicts
  rather than decides — paintings shown every 57 years at Point Nemo — and otherwise
  **"prefers to watch from afar, admiring how each creature paints their own path forward into
  the nebulous unknown."**

  Her **edicts** are Sable's whole character, stated by someone else:
  - *"Fill the world with color."*
  - *"Embrace the mystery of the future."*

  Her **anathema**:
  - *"Losing yourself to monotony."*
  - *"Attempting to see what has yet to occur."*

  > [!important] Why she's the only god a Ronin can actually follow
  > A Ronin is beholden to no code but their own — so any deity who issues
  > orders is a contradiction. Kismet doesn't. She **watches you paint your own path**. Following
  > her costs you nothing you swore not to give.
  >
  > And the fit with the species is exact. **Chaos** took your people's color.
  > Kismet's first edict is *fill the world with color*, and her anathema is *losing yourself to
  > monotony* — which is precisely the half of the Shadar-Kai who "found serenity in their
  > monochromaticity." Sable follows the one power in the cosmos whose stated purpose is undoing
  > what was done to her people. A woman named for **black**, serving the **Painter**.

- **Aecet, Ruination** — kept as the antagonist. *"The dark hand to chaos,"* Chaotic Evil, the god
  whose watch over his dominion is the Decline itself → Shadar-Kai.
- **Homeland?** `TBD` — Surging Sea, Rift Sea & Central Corridor, Calidun Sea, Northern
  Wilderness, Southern Wilderness.
- **Faction history?** `TBD` — thirteen parties of influence, including the **War Dogs Mercenary
  Co.** and **The Wayfinders Guild**, both plausible former employers for a wandering sword.
